title: Review Options for Bukit Panjang LRT System
what_it_is: Review Options for Bukit Panjang LRT System

sections.label: LRT alternatives found not feasible
sections.summary: LTA concluded that replacing the LRT with buses or autonomous vehicles is not feasible after traffic studies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: These included replacing the LRT system with a non-LRT option, such as running more buses or even autonomous vehicles on the existing roads and LRT viaducts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: But after extensive traffic studies, LTA concluded that these alternatives, which would require an extended shutdown of the BPLRT to modify the viaducts, are just not feasible.

sections.label: Bombardier awarded LTA contract
sections.summary: After evaluation with SMRT, the LTA Board awarded the contract to Bombardier in March this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: After a thorough evaluation with Singapore Mass Rapid Transit (SMRT), the LTA Board decided to award the contract to Bombardier in March this year.

sections.label: New wireless CBTC signalling system
sections.summary: The renewal adopts a new wireless Communications-Based Train Control signalling system with better built-in redundancy.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: With the renewal, we will adopt a new wireless Communications-Based Train Control (CBTC) signalling system with better built-in redundancy.

sections.label: Upgrading completed by 2024
sections.summary: Overhaul, replacement and upgrading of critical components will be fully completed by 2024, with smoother rides from 2022.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: The overhaul, replacement and upgrading of all these critical components and sub-systems will be fully completed by 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: However, commuters can begin to enjoy smoother and more reliable rides from 2022, when the upgraded trains and signalling system come into operation.

sections.label: Current reliability measure MKBF
sections.summary: The reliability measure, Mean Kilometres Between Failures, is barely 50,000 kilometres today.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: Today, the reliability measure, the Mean Kilometres Between Failures (MKBF), is barely 50,000 kilometres (km).

sections.label: New system not viable
sections.summary: After extensive discussions and simulations, the decision was that a completely new system is not viable.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: You got to do extensive civil engineering work on the viaducts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: We got to pull down, rebuild and reconfigure – months of suspension of the BPLRT.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: We have studied, and I was game for a completely new system – close it down and have all buses either running on existing roads or on the viaducts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: But the roads just cannot take the peak-hour load unless you throw out all the cars, in other words, no cars at all in Bukit Panjang Town, and every lane will become a bus lane.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: That is why, after extensive discussions and simulations, we decided that it is not viable.

sections.label: Quarters of 2020 and 2022
sections.summary: The speaker recalls the first two items are in the third quarter of 2020 and the remaining ones in the fourth quarter of 2022.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: If I remember correctly, it is the third quarter of 2020 for the first two, and the remaining ones like in the fourth quarter of 2022.

sections.label: Bombardier and new train order
sections.summary: Bombardier knew of pressure to improve service quickly, and the order for new trains is firm and committed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: But Bombardier knew that there is huge pressure from all of us to improve the service as quickly as possible.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: So, the order for new trains is firm, it is committed.
